title: 二进制转换
problem_statement_md:
二进制数字系统只使用两个数字，即**0**和**1**。
计算机底层以二进制进行运算，这意味着它们只用0和1来存储数据和进行计算。

你需要写一个程序，将整数转换成二进制表示。
创建一个**Converter**类，其中有一个静态的 **toBinary()** 方法，它返回其参数的二进制形式。

在main方法中的代码将输入一个数字并调用相应的静态方法。确保代码按预期运行。

你可以使用以下代码将一个数字转换为二进制：

```java
String binary=""；
while(num > 0) {
   binary = (num%2)+binary；
   num /= 2；
}

```

上面的代码使用一个循环将**num**转换为二进制，并将结果存储在 **binary** 字符串中。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Binary Converter[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

The binary numeric system uses only two digits: 0 and 1. Computers operate in binary, meaning they store data and perform calculations using only zeros and ones.

You need to make a program to convert integer numbers to their binary representation. 
Create a [b]Converter[/b] class with a static [b]toBinary()[/b] method, which returns the binary version of its argument.
The code in main takes a number as input and calls the corresponding static method. Make sure the code works as expected.

[b]Sample Input:[/b]
42
[b]Sample Output: [/b]
101010

You can use the following code to convert a number to binary:
[code format="java" ]String binary="";
while(num > 0) {
   binary = (num%2)+binary;
   num /= 2;
}
[/code]
[note]The code above uses a loop to convert [b]num[/b] to binary and stores the result in the [b]binary[/b] String.[/note]
